purpose: Reproducible exploratory agreement diagnostic for collar accelerometer features against the source's RumiWatch instrument classifications; not human-observed behavior validation or independent external validation.

source.population: 18 finishing steers in indoor straw housing with ad libitum TMR across three UK farm trials; breed and exact age are not specified in the README.
source.sourceSplit: README marks animals 04, 10, and 11 as test animals; the remaining 15 animals are training animals. The primary article has already reported a test result using these source-test animals, so this can reproduce a source split but is not a new literature-independent holdout.

analysisCohort.timeUnit: one source-naive wall-clock second per animal
analysisCohort.alignment: exact timestamp equality only; no time shifting, nearest-neighbor match, interpolation, or resampling
analysisCohort.eligibleRows: Retain a second only when it contains exactly 10 exact-timestamp collar/halter pairs, every required collar axis and reference label is valid, and the reference-label majority is unique. Exclude tied reference labels from fitting and scoring, and report their count and fraction.
analysisCohort.target: Unique per-second majority of source RumiWatch class codes: 0 other, 1 rumination, 2 eating-or-drinking.
analysisCohort.leakageControls: Reference label fields, animal ID, trial ID, timestamp, and split are never model predictors. No second or animal crosses a grouped training/test boundary. Feature generation uses collar values only; target aggregation uses halter values only.

models.model: Predict the eligible source-train class with the greatest total equal-animal-weighted mass for every source-test second; resolve weighted-mass ties by the smaller numeric class code.
RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=12, min_samples_leaf=10, max_features='sqrt', class_weight='balanced_subsample', n_jobs=1, random_state=20261013).
models.trainingWeights: Equal total sample weight per source-train animal; within an animal, each eligible second receives weight 1 / number of that animal's eligible seconds.

evaluation.development: For the fixed Random Forest only, run leave-one-animal-out predictions over the 15 source-train animals. This is descriptive model development and cannot change features, labels, model parameters, or the final source-test protocol.
evaluation.finalTest: Fit each fixed prediction rule using all 15 source-train animals, then evaluate once on source-test animals 04, 10, and 11. Preserve the test outputs and report each animal separately as well as pooled rows.
evaluation.primaryMetric: Pooled source-test macro-F1 over the three fixed classes, accompanied by class support and the confusion matrix.
requiredMetrics: per-animal accuracy and macro-F1 when all classes are present
complete-second and tied-label coverage by animal
evaluation.uncertainty: Report results for the three source-test animals individually. Do not bootstrap seconds as if independent; do not infer population-level coverage, confidence, calibration, farm transfer, or trial transfer from three animals.

interpretationLimits: RumiWatch labels are instrument-derived reference classifications, not human-video-confirmed ground truth in the downloaded package.
The source merges drinking into eating, so those activities cannot be distinguished.
The source-test animals were already used for testing in the primary article; the Riose analysis may preserve them untouched but cannot call them a new independent literature holdout.
One test animal per trial does not support a held-out trial or farm generalization claim.

This housed finishing-steer sensor-to-instrument agreement task does not validate grazing behavior, mature-cow behavior, DMI, ADG, forage biomass, uncertainty calibration, or the Riose simulation engine.

reproducibility.noParameterSearch: No parameter search, feature selection, or test-set adaptation is allowed.
